description: This file defines interfaces for managing process containers within the WPEFramework. It includes abstract classes for iterating over network interfaces, container memory and processor info, and container lifecycle management, including creation, control, and information retrieval.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating network interfaces in a container, providing methods to get interface name, number of addresses, and specific IP address.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface providing memory usage statistics for a container, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface providing CPU usage information for a container, including total usage, per-core usage, and core count.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Iterator for enumerating containers, primarily providing container ID.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance, offering methods to retrieve ID, PID, memory, CPU info, network interfaces, and control methods to start and stop the container.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Static method to get the singleton instance of IContainerAdministrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all created containers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID.

ctags.name: IContainerIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/

ctags.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class INetworkInterfaceIterator : public Core::IIterator,  public Core::IReferenceCounted  {$/
